lines.v1: the oldest generation of the previous markup
lines.v2: the middle generation of the previous markup
lines.v4: the latest generation of the previous markup (YPY native names differ only by prefix)

severities.quebra: stops working after swapping to YPY
severities.muda: keeps working but behaves differently from the native YPY; review before going native
severities.aviso: works; only the spelling is legacy and a native spelling exists (ypy migrate converts it)

rules.what: This script tag loads the library the project used before YPY.
rules.fix: Replace this tag with the YPY script tag (level 1 migration: nothing else has to change).

rules.what: This script tag loads an extension written for the previous markup.
rules.fix: Remove it when YPY ships the equivalent (sse, ws, head, preload, morph); keep it only for extensions that use the legacy extension API, which YPY does not offer.

rules.what: Attributes use the legacy {A} prefix (ypy migrate converts it).
rules.fix: Run `ypy migrate --write` to convert the legacy prefix to ypy- (the data- spelling becomes data-ypy-).

rules.what: The configuration meta tag uses the legacy name (still read).
rules.fix: Rename the meta tag; the legacy name is merged first, so ypy-config wins when both exist.

rules.what: Legacy state class (the default configuration applies both the legacy and the ypy- class); also inside nested CSS and CSS written in a Go string.
rules.fix: Style the ypy- class (or the data-ypy-state attribute) and drop the legacy one.

rules.what: Uses the legacy global name; `ypy` is the native global (the alias stays available).
Event with an unchanged name but the legacy prefix (still dispatched).
rules.fix: Listen to the ypy: event with the same name.

rules.what: Event with the legacy prefix (generation v4 markup).
rules.fix: Replace the {P}: prefix with ypy: (same event name); `ypy migrate --write` does it.

rules.what: The {A}sse attribute of the v1 markup is gone.
rules.fix: Use the SSE attribute: ypy-sse:connect="/url" (swap targets and events follow the native model).

rules.what: The {A}ws attribute of the v1 markup is gone.
The "event: code" form of the {A}on attribute is not supported.
rules.fix: Write one ypy-on:<event> attribute per handler, or the arrow form ypy-on="click -> code".

rules.what: useTemplateFragments no longer exists; responses are always parsed through <template>.
DELETE requests carried the form values in the body in v1 markup; later generations send them as URL parameters or not at all.
rules.fix: Check the server handler: read DELETE data from the query string, or add ypy-include explicitly.

rules.what: Request to an absolute URL: cross-origin requests are blocked by default since v2 markup.
rules.fix: If the URL is on another origin, set config.mode to "cors" (the old selfRequestsOnly=false).

rules.what: {A}vars is removed.
rules.fix: Use ypy-vals with the js: prefix: ypy-vals="js:{a: 1}".

rules.what: {A}params is removed.
rules.fix: Filter the parameters in a ypy:config:request listener (detail.ctx.request.body is a FormData).

rules.what: {A}prompt moved to an extension.
rules.fix: Load the prompt extension (ypy-prompt.js); the attribute and the YPY-Prompt header stay the same.

rules.what: {A}ext is removed: extensions are active when their script is included.
rules.fix: Delete the attribute and keep the extension script; restrict extensions with config.extensions if needed.

rules.what: {A}disinherit is removed: inheritance is explicit.
rules.fix: Delete it, and add :inherited to the attributes that must reach descendants.

rules.what: {A}inherit is removed: inheritance is explicit.
rules.fix: Delete it, and add :inherited to the attributes that must reach descendants.

rules.what: {A}request is replaced by ypy-config.
rules.fix: Rename to ypy-config; it accepts the same JSON (timeout, credentials, noHeaders).

rules.what: {A}history="false" is removed: history snapshots are no longer kept in localStorage.
{A}disable (without a value) means "skip processing" here, but a different thing in the native attribute set.
rules.fix: Rename to ypy-ignore. Do this before renaming ypy-disabled-elt to ypy-disable.

rules.what: {A}disabled-elt is renamed.
rules.fix: Rename to ypy-disable (after ypy-disable became ypy-ignore).

rules.what: The dash spelling of {A}on ({A}on-click, {A}on--after-swap) works only when config.metaCharacter is "-".
rules.fix: Use the colon spelling (ypy-on:click, ypy-on::after:swap), or set config.metaCharacter to "-" and keep the dashes.

rules.what: Out-of-band swaps now run after the main swap, and an OOB-only response no longer empties the main target.
rules.fix: Review code that depends on the order; to restore the old empty swap use config.allowEmptySwapAfterOOB or swapEmpty:true.

rules.what: sse-connect is renamed.
sse-close is renamed.
sse-swap is not supported: unnamed messages are swapped automatically and named events become DOM events.
rules.fix: Drop sse-swap and listen to the named events (ypy-on) or send unnamed messages.

rules.what: ws-connect is renamed.
ws-send is renamed.
The preload attribute of the preload extension is renamed.
rules.fix: Rename to ypy-preload (values such as mouseover are unchanged).

rules.what: The response-targets extension attributes are replaced by ypy-status.
The idiomorph swap style is built in and renamed.
rules.fix: Use innerMorph or outerMorph (no extension needed).

rules.what: The show:<selector>:<position> and scroll:<selector>:<position> modifiers use separate keys now.
The queue: trigger modifier is replaced by ypy-sync.
rules.fix: Use ypy-sync="this:queue last" (or queue first, queue all, drop, abort).

rules.what: The inherit keyword of {A}include and {A}indicator is gone.
rules.fix: Put the shared value on the parent with the :inherited:append modifier (ypy-include:inherited:append="#shared").

rules.what: Attribute inherited implicitly by descendants; inheritance is explicit now.
rules.fix: Add :inherited to the attribute on the container, for example ypy-target:inherited="#out". Do not add it blindly: only where a descendant relies on it.

rules.what: A DELETE request inside a <form> no longer includes the form values.
rules.fix: Add ypy-include="closest form" to the element.

rules.what: Legacy event {P}:afterOnLoad is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:afterProcessNode is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:afterRequest is renamed.
rules.fix: Listen to ypy:finally:request (it fires on failures too, as the old event did; ypy:after:request fires before the swap).

rules.what: Legacy event {P}:afterSettle is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:afterSwap is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:beforeCleanupElement is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:beforeHistorySave is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:beforeHistoryUpdate is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:beforeOnLoad is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:beforeProcessNode is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:beforeRequest is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:beforeSend is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:beforeSwap is renamed.
rules.fix: Listen to ypy:before:swap (the swap decision moved to config.noSwap and ypy-status).

rules.what: Legacy event {P}:beforeTransition is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:configRequest is renamed.
rules.fix: Listen to ypy:config:request (detail.ctx.request replaces detail.headers, parameters and path).

rules.what: Legacy event {P}:historyCacheMiss is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:historyRestore is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:load is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:oobAfterSwap is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:oobBeforeSwap is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:pushedIntoHistory is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:replacedInHistory is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:responseError is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:sendAbort is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:sendError is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:swapError is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:targetError is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:timeout is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:prompt is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:sseOpen is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:sseError is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:sseBeforeMessage is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:sseMessage is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:sseClose is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:wsOpen is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:wsClose is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:wsError is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:wsConfigSend is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:wsBeforeSend is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:wsAfterSend is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:wsBeforeMessage is renamed.
Legacy event {P}:wsAfterMessage is renamed.
{P}:validation:validate: Validation events are gone: validation uses the browser constraint API.
rules.fix: Use native form validation (checkValidity, the invalid event) or validate in a ypy:config:request listener.

rules.what: {P}:validation:failed: Validation events are gone: validation uses the browser constraint API.
rules.fix: Use the native invalid event on the field.

rules.what: {P}:validation:halted: Validation events are gone: validation uses the browser constraint API.
rules.fix: Use the native invalid event on the form.

rules.what: {P}:xhr:loadstart: XHR events are gone: requests use fetch.
{P}:xhr:loadend: XHR events are gone: requests use fetch.
{P}:xhr:progress: XHR progress events are gone: requests use fetch.
rules.fix: No equivalent for upload progress; use ypy:before:request and a fetch based upload where needed.

rules.what: {P}:xhr:abort: XHR events are gone: requests use fetch.
{P}:historyCacheMissLoad: History cache events no longer exist: the history snapshot cache is an optional extension.
rules.fix: Load the ypy-history-cache extension or remove the listener.

rules.what: {P}:historyCacheMissLoadError: History cache events no longer exist: the history snapshot cache is an optional extension.
rules.fix: Load the ypy-history-cache extension or remove the listener.

rules.what: {P}:historyCacheError: History cache events no longer exist: the history snapshot cache is an optional extension.
rules.fix: Load the ypy-history-cache extension or remove the listener.

rules.what: {P}:historyCacheHit: History cache events no longer exist: the history snapshot cache is an optional extension.
rules.fix: Load the ypy-history-cache extension or remove the listener.

rules.what: {P}:historyItemCreated: History cache events no longer exist: the history snapshot cache is an optional extension.
{P}:validateUrl: The egress check event no longer exists: cross-origin requests are controlled by config.mode.
rules.fix: Set config.mode to "cors" or "same-origin"; veto a request in a ypy:config:request listener.

rules.what: {P}:processTemplate: Partials work differently: <ypy-partial> is handled by the core.
rules.fix: Use the partial attributes of the core instead of a custom template handler.

rules.what: {P}:oobErrorNoTarget: This diagnostic event no longer exists.
{P}:onLoadError: This diagnostic event no longer exists.
{P}:evalDisallowedError: This diagnostic event no longer exists.
The swap decision properties of the old beforeSwap detail are gone.
rules.fix: Decide per status with config.noSwap or ypy-status:<code>="swap:none"; edit the response in ypy:before:swap (detail.ctx.text).

rules.what: The old event detail (xhr, requestConfig, parameters, headers, verb) is replaced by detail.ctx.
rules.fix: Read and write detail.ctx.request (headers, body as FormData, action, method) and detail.ctx.response.

rules.what: The addClass() method of the legacy API is removed.
The removeClass() method of the legacy API is removed.
The toggleClass() method of the legacy API is removed.
The closest() method of the legacy API is removed.
The remove() method of the legacy API is removed.
The off() method of the legacy API is removed.
The location() method of the legacy API is removed.
The takeClass() method of the legacy API is removed.
rules.fix: Use a few lines with classList, or ypy.live.take() from the live extension.
rules.native: a few lines with classList, or ypy.live.take() from the live extension

rules.what: The logAll() method of the legacy API is removed.
The logNone() method of the legacy API is removed.
The logger() method of the legacy API is removed.
rules.fix: Use console.* (the library logs there directly).

rules.what: The values() method of the legacy API is removed.
The defineExtension() method of the legacy API is removed.
rules.fix: Use ypy.registerExtension() (the extension API is event based; rewrite the extension).
rules.native: ypy.registerExtension() (the extension API is event based; rewrite the extension)

rules.what: Config key defaultSwapStyle is renamed to defaultSwap.
Config key globalViewTransitions is renamed to transitions.
Config key historyEnabled is renamed to history.
Config key includeIndicatorStyles is renamed to includeIndicatorCSS.
Config key timeout is renamed to defaultTimeout.
rules.fix: Use defaultTimeout: the default is 60000 ms natively (0 meant "no timeout").

rules.what: Config key selfRequestsOnly is renamed to mode.
rules.fix: Use mode: selfRequestsOnly: true is mode: "same-origin", false is mode: "cors".

rules.what: Config key disableInheritance is renamed to implicitInheritance.
rules.fix: Use implicitInheritance: the meaning is inverted: disableInheritance: false is implicitInheritance: true.

rules.what: Config key requestClass is renamed to classes.request.
Config key indicatorClass is renamed to classes.indicator.
Config key addedClass is renamed to classes.added.
Config key settlingClass is renamed to classes.settling.
Config key swappingClass is renamed to classes.swapping.
Config key allowEval is removed.
rules.fix: Set the Content-Security-Policy instead; evaluation of ypy-vals js: and ypy-on is controlled by the page policy.

rules.what: Config key allowScriptTags is removed.
rules.fix: Scripts in swapped content follow the browser rules; sanitize on the server.

rules.what: Config key allowNestedOobSwaps is removed.
rules.fix: Nested OOB swaps are always processed.

rules.what: Config key attributesToSettle is removed.
Config key defaultSwapDelay is removed.
rules.fix: Use the swap: modifier on ypy-swap.

rules.what: Config key disableSelector is removed.
Config key getCacheBusterParam is removed.
rules.fix: Add the parameter in a ypy:config:request listener.

rules.what: Config key historyCacheSize is removed.
rules.fix: Load the ypy-history-cache extension for snapshots.

rules.what: Config key methodsThatUseUrlParams is removed.
rules.fix: Parameters of GET requests go in the URL; other methods send a body.

rules.what: Config key refreshOnHistoryMiss is removed.
rules.fix: History restores are fetched; there is no cache miss setting.

rules.what: Config key responseHandling is removed.
rules.fix: Use config.noSwap (a list of status codes) or ypy-status:<code>="swap:none".

rules.what: Config key scrollBehavior is removed.
rules.fix: Use the scroll behavior of the page CSS (scroll-behavior).

rules.what: Config key scrollIntoViewOnBoost is removed.
rules.fix: Use the show:/scroll: modifiers on ypy-swap.

rules.what: Config key triggerSpecsCache is removed.
Config key withCredentials is removed.
Config key wsBinaryType is removed.
rules.fix: Set it on the connection in a ypy:ws:before:connection listener.

rules.what: Config key wsReconnectDelay is removed.
Config key reportValidityOfForms is removed.
rules.fix: Forms are validated through reportValidity; use ypy-validate="false" to skip it.

rules.what: Config key ignoreTitle is removed.
rules.fix: Use the title handling of the swap (ypy-swap ignoreTitle:true).

rules.what: The {H}Trigger-After-Swap response header is removed.
rules.fix: Send YPY-Trigger (events fire after the swap) or dispatch the event from a ypy:after:swap listener.

rules.what: The {H}Trigger-After-Settle response header is removed.
rules.fix: Send YPY-Trigger or dispatch the event from a ypy:after:settle listener.

rules.what: The {H}Trigger request header is replaced by YPY-Source, in the tag#id format.
rules.fix: Read YPY-Source (for example button#save); the old header carried only the element id.

rules.what: The {H}Trigger-Name request header is removed.
rules.fix: Read YPY-Source, or send the value in the request body.

rules.what: The {H}Target request header changes from the element id to tag#id.
rules.fix: Compare against the tag#id format (for example main#content).

rules.what: The {H}Prompt request header needs the prompt extension.
The event is written in the ypy: namespace but YPY does not emit it, so the listener never runs (typical after a migration that only swapped the prefix).
rules.fix: Use a name of the event table of YPY (ypy:after:swap, ypy:after:settle, ypy:before:request, ypy:finally:request, ypy:after:process...); `ypy migrate --write` repairs the legacy names.

rules.what:
Identifier named after the legacy prefix (a prop, field or variable such as

Target,

_request, Is

); the templates now say ypy.
rules.fix: Rename the whole identifier (`ypy migrate --write` renames it in every file; --no-identifiers keeps it).

rules.what: The element is not in the detail of a YPY event: detail.elt is undefined.
rules.fix: Read evt.target (the element the event was fired on).

rules.what: The target header carries the plain id of the element; YPY sends tag#id (a request in a test or a client written with the id only does not match).
rules.fix: Write the header as tag#id, for example main#content.
